optimizedDescription.value: GetGraphHealth aggregates statistics, freshness, coverage, VCS staleness, and fingerprint diagnostics on an open provider.

optimizedContext.value:
# Get Graph Health

## Rules

- `GetGraphHealth.execute(input)` returns all `GraphStatistics` + `stale`, `currentRef`, `fingerprintMismatch`, content/coverage, `state`, `knownStaleSinceLastIndex`, reason codes, ordered workspace health.
- Availability via `provider.getStatistics()`; propagate busy/stale unchanged. No lock helpers or caller escape hatch. Input: `config`, open provider, `codeGraphVersion`, optional workspaces; never open/close. `createGetGraphHealth()` stateless, no config capture.
- VCS: `createVcsAdapter(config.projectRoot)` + `isGraphStale(lastIndexedRef, currentRef)`; `lastIndexedRef === null` → `stale: null`.
- Fingerprint: if workspaces and `stats.graphFingerprint` exist, effective config + `detectFingerprintMismatch(codeGraphVersion, projectRoot, workspaces, graphConfig)`; else not comparable → `null`.
- Freshness/coverage: expose working-tree/content state, schema/generation compatibility, partial, summaries/reasons for excluded/unsupported/parse-failed/partial. `excluded`/`unsupported` terminal visible, do NOT incomplete aggregate coverage; `parse-failed`/`partial` do. Discovery/stat/read/hash failure → unknown, never false mismatch/stale latch. No indexing; only refresh equal-content observations + monotonic workspace/global latches.
- `coverageCompleteness`: `complete` | `complete-with-warnings` | `incomplete` | `unknown`; `coverageWarnings` ordered `{ code, count }`. Only defined warning code `file-too-large` (count of `unsupported`/`file-too-large` records). Derive: incomplete when aggregate incomplete; unknown when unassessable; `complete-with-warnings` when complete + non-empty warnings; else `complete`. Warnings empty when incomplete/unknown. Boolean `coverageComplete` stays `true` for `complete-with-warnings`. Other unsupported/excluded MUST NOT raise warnings. Treat `complete-with-warnings` as absence unproven for size-skipped files.
- Integrity: indexed coverage MUST correspond to expected File/Document in same generation. Missing node, impossible counts, or completed generation over empty/partial graph → `contentFresh`/`coverageComplete` false, state not current, `GRAPH_CONTENT_INCONSISTENT`. Excluded/unsupported need no node. No repair; diagnostic for reindex/recovery.
- Aggregate: `state` current/stale/unknown; precedence stale > unknown > current. True aggregate latch → stale without rescan. Transient failure → unknown without latch change. Global failures MAY affect aggregate without false workspace cause. Structured keeps all workspaces; text = aggregate + non-current only; no absolute roots.
- Efficiency: VCS workspaces by repo root share normalized modified paths filtered by visibility. Excluded-only changes leave latches unchanged. Non-VCS: compare visible membership/observations; hash only when mtime/size differs; refresh equal; stop on first proven mismatch. Inspect failure → unknown unless independent stale evidence. NEVER every symbol or directed assessment of whole graph. Size-skipped (`unsupported`/`file-too-large`) terminal, not indexed members — index+skip run stays current until files/limits change; previously indexed file growing past limit → membership change.

## Constraints

- No indexing, destructive recreation, or arbitrary graph mutation.
- MAY mutate only semantic freshness cache: equal-content observations + monotonic latches.
- MUST NOT load change entities or compile project context.
- Already-open provider: never open/close.
